summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscated (_0xXXXX identifiers, string-map dispatch) and at install time downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), extracts it, chmods the binary +x, and executes the sibling file math_init.js under Bun via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line obfuscated blob marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' with a rotating string-array decoder (WV8StW rotator, hc1jfK9 decoder over a ~2500-entry constant table); it is not referenced by dist/index.js and does not relate to the package's advertised Datadog component-usage functionality. Running `npm install @servicetitan/component-usage@28.5.4` triggers arbitrary code execution on the installer's host via the alternate-runtime dropper pattern, chosen to evade Node-based static analyzers that cannot execute or trace bun-cjs bytecode.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
